The '''Pedd system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[D'Astan sector/Legends|D'Astan sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the astronomical object [[Pedd Four]].
